name: Dave Gerrits AI Content Generator
author: Dave

sections.description:
Dave Gerrits AI Content Generator is a Dutch AI content generator and blog generator for WordPress, specifically developed for Dutch-language websites and Dutch-speaking users.

Create Dutch blog title ideas and complete Dutch blog articles directly from your WordPress dashboard. The plugin interface is in Dutch and all generated content is written in Dutch.

You stay in control: content generation is started manually and you decide what to do with the generated content. The plugin works as a standalone free WordPress plugin and does not require a paid Dave Gerrits license. To generate content, you use your own OpenAI API key.

Blog Title Generator

Enter a topic and let the plugin generate 10 Dutch-language blog title ideas.

You can select one of the generated titles and send it directly to the Blog Generator. The selected title is automatically filled into the blog title field, so you do not have to copy and paste it manually.

The article itself is not generated automatically. You remain in control and manually start article generation from the Blog Generator.

Blog Generator

You can enter your own blog title directly in the Blog Generator. Using the Blog Title Generator is optional. If you select a generated title there, it is automatically filled into the Blog Generator.

Enter a blog title, optionally provide additional instructions and choose a target article length of approximately 700, 1000 or 1500 words. You can also save one optional writing style in the Blog Generator. This saved style is automatically applied to future generated articles until you change or remove it.

The plugin then generates a Dutch-language article with a clear HTML structure:

  • Exactly one H1 heading
  • Logical H2 headings
  • H3 headings where appropriate
  • Clearly structured paragraphs
  • A readable article structure

The generated article is displayed as a formatted preview. With the copy button, you can copy the article and then paste it manually into the WordPress editor.

After article generation, the plugin also automatically prepares SEO data that you can use with your article. The meta description is limited to a maximum of 140 characters.

This free plugin does not automatically schedule, generate or publish articles. You start every generation request manually and decide what to do with the generated content.

Always review AI-generated content for accuracy before publishing.

Optional AI Featured Image

In version 1.2.0, the Blog Generator can optionally generate one matching AI featured image together with the article.

Image generation remains fully manual. Enable the “AI featured image” option before generating the article and choose one of two image styles:

  • Editorial illustration – recommended for blogs, news and content websites
  • Photorealistic – realistic photo-style imagery

The free plugin uses GPT Image 2 with the budget quality setting and a fixed 1536×1024 landscape format. Users can choose WebP, JPG or PNG before generating the image. WebP is selected by default and is recommended because it usually requires much less storage space.

After the article is generated, the AI image request starts automatically when the image option is enabled. Image generation can take noticeably longer than text generation, so the plugin displays a clear waiting message while GPT Image 2 is working.

The generated image is shown next to the article as a preview. It is not automatically attached to a WordPress post. You decide whether to save it to the WordPress Media Library.

When you save the image, the plugin automatically uses the blog title for the image filename, media title and alt text. The blog title is never rendered as visible text inside the generated image.

AI image generation uses your own OpenAI API key and may result in additional OpenAI API charges.

Use your own OpenAI API key

Dave Gerrits AI Content Generator uses your own OpenAI API key.

In the settings, you can configure your API key and the AI model you want to use. A built-in connection test lets you verify that the connection to OpenAI is working.

Use of the OpenAI API may result in charges from OpenAI according to the terms and pricing of your own OpenAI account.

Looking for more automation?

In addition to this free manual AI Content Generator, Dave Gerrits also offers Content AI Agent: a more advanced commercial WordPress plugin for Dutch-language content and content automation.

Content AI Agent includes additional and advanced features such as:

  • Planning content weeks or months ahead
  • Automatically generating and publishing articles
  • Automatically filling SEO data in supported workflows when using Yoast SEO or Rank Math
  • Automatically generating and attaching high-quality AI featured images with additional image styles and quality options
  • Generating content ideas
  • Building content clusters with the Content Cluster Planner
  • Using multiple writing style profiles
  • Creating different content types, including posts, pages and WooCommerce descriptions
  • Adding custom HTML during blog generation
  • Rewriting existing articles
  • Optimizing existing content
  • Generating FAQ content
  • Processing and rewriting RSS content
  • Advanced queues and content automation
  • Analyzing your website for internal linking opportunities
  • Adding smart internal links

More information about Content AI Agent:
https://davegerrits.nl/content-ai-agent/

External services

This plugin connects to the OpenAI API to generate Dutch-language blog articles, blog title ideas and, when manually enabled, AI featured images.

When you manually start a generation request, the plugin sends the information required for that request to OpenAI. This may include the blog title, topic, additional instructions, your saved writing style and requested article length. When AI image generation is enabled, the blog title and relevant article content are also used to create the image prompt sent to OpenAI.

Data is sent to OpenAI only when you manually start a content or image generation request, or when you use the built-in OpenAI connection test.

The connection to OpenAI uses the API key that you enter in the plugin settings. AI requests are sent directly to OpenAI and are not routed through a Dave Gerrits server.

This external service is provided by OpenAI.

OpenAI Services Agreement:
https://openai.com/policies/services-agreement/

OpenAI Service Terms:
https://openai.com/policies/service-terms/

OpenAI Privacy Policy:
https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/

By using the OpenAI API, you are responsible for complying with OpenAI’s terms and privacy policy.

Source code and build process

All custom source code required to use and modify this plugin is included directly in the plugin package.

The JavaScript and CSS files in the assets directory are human-readable source files. This plugin does not use npm, webpack or another external build process, and there are no separate compiled or minified distribution files required to build the plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin through WordPress or upload the dave-gerrits-ai-content-generator folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open the Dave Gerrits AI Content Generator settings.
  4. Enter your own OpenAI API key.
  5. Choose the AI model if desired.
  6. Save the settings.
  7. Use the connection test to verify the OpenAI connection.
  8. Open the Blog Title Generator or Blog Generator to manually generate Dutch-language content.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin specifically made for Dutch WordPress websites?

Yes. Dave Gerrits AI Content Generator is specifically developed for Dutch-language WordPress websites and Dutch-speaking users. The plugin interface is in Dutch and generated content is written in Dutch.

Do I need an OpenAI API key?

Yes. The plugin uses your own OpenAI API key to generate blog titles and articles.

Is this plugin free to use?

Dave Gerrits AI Content Generator does not require a paid Dave Gerrits license. OpenAI may charge for API usage through your own OpenAI account.

Can I send a generated blog title directly to the Blog Generator?

Yes. Since version 1.1.0, you can select one of the 10 generated blog titles and use the “Use selected title” button. The title is then automatically filled into the Blog Generator.

Do I have to use the Blog Title Generator?

No. The Blog Title Generator is optional. If you already have a blog title, you can enter it directly in the Blog Generator and generate your article from there.

Can I generate complete blog articles?

Yes. You can enter a blog title, optionally provide additional instructions and choose the desired article length. The plugin then generates a complete Dutch-language article.

How closely does the plugin follow the selected article length?

You can choose approximately 700, 1000 or 1500 words. The plugin targets the selected length and, when a first draft is clearly too short, can automatically perform one additional expansion pass to get closer to the requested word count.

Can I save a writing style?

Yes. Since version 1.1.0, you can save one optional writing style in the Blog Generator. The saved style is automatically used for future generated articles. The free plugin does not include multiple writing style profiles.

Does the generated article contain headings?

Yes. The output uses one H1 heading, logical H2 headings and H3 headings where appropriate.

Does the plugin prepare SEO data?

Yes. After generating an article, the plugin automatically prepares SEO data that you can directly use with the article. The meta description is limited to a maximum of 140 characters.

Is the generated article automatically added to WordPress?

No. The generated article is displayed as a formatted preview. You copy the article with the copy button and then paste it manually into the WordPress editor.

Does this plugin automatically schedule or publish articles?

No. Dave Gerrits AI Content Generator is intended for manual content generation. Automatic planning, generation and publishing are available in the more advanced Content AI Agent plugin.

Should I review AI-generated content before publishing?

Yes. Always review factual accuracy, spelling, links and suitability for your audience before publishing AI-generated content.

Can the free plugin generate an AI featured image?

Yes. Since version 1.2.0, you can manually enable an optional AI featured image in the Blog Generator. The image is generated with GPT Image 2 using the budget quality setting.

Why does the AI featured image take longer to appear?

AI image generation usually takes longer than text generation. When the image option is enabled, the article is generated first and GPT Image 2 then creates the featured image. The plugin shows a waiting message until the preview is ready.

Which image file formats are available?

You can choose WebP, JPG or PNG. WebP is the default and recommended option because it generally uses much less storage space while maintaining good image quality.

Which image styles are available?

The free plugin includes Editorial illustration and Photorealistic. Content AI Agent provides more image styles, quality choices and automated image workflows.

Is the generated image automatically added to my post?

No. The image is shown as a preview first. You manually choose whether to save it to the WordPress Media Library, and you select it yourself when creating or editing your WordPress post.

Does AI image generation cost extra?

It can. The image is generated through your own OpenAI API key and OpenAI may charge separately for image generation according to your OpenAI account and current pricing.
sections.changelog:
1.2.1

  • Added a file format choice for AI featured images: WebP, JPG or PNG.
  • WebP is now the default and recommended format because it generally requires much less storage space.
  • Updated the Blog Generator help text, FAQ and documentation.

1.2.0

  • Replaced the low-use ‘dutch content’ tag with ‘content writer’.
  • Shortened the WordPress.org short description to stay within the 150-character limit.
  • Added a clear waiting message while GPT Image 2 generates the image preview.
  • Expanded the user guide, FAQ and readme for the complete v1.2.0 workflow.
  • Fixed AI featured image generation so it starts after the article has been generated.
  • Improved article length targeting for the 700, 1000 and 1500 word options, including an automatic expansion pass when the first draft is too short.
  • Added optional manual AI featured image generation to the Blog Generator.
  • Added GPT Image 2 image generation using the budget quality setting and fixed 1536×1024 landscape format.
  • Added two image styles: Editorial illustration and Photorealistic.
  • Added a two-column article and image preview layout on desktop.
  • Added a manual option to save the generated image to the WordPress Media Library.
  • Image filename, media title and alt text are automatically based on the blog title.
  • The blog title is not rendered as visible text inside the generated image.
  • Added temporary preview cleanup when an image is generated but not saved.
  • Updated Support & Help, FAQ, External Services documentation and Content AI Agent comparison.

1.1.3

  • Updated WordPress.org tags to focus more strongly on Dutch users looking for AI content and blog generation.
  • Improved the short description with clearer Dutch positioning.
  • Improved the opening plugin description for better relevance to Dutch WordPress users.
  • Updated FAQ wording to make the Dutch-language focus clearer.
  • No changes to the content generation workflow.

1.1.2

  • Clarified that the Blog Title Generator is optional and that users can enter their own blog title directly in the Blog Generator.
  • Expanded the Content AI Agent information with support for adding custom HTML during blog generation.
  • Updated the FAQ and documentation.

1.1.1

  • Removed the configurable language field so the plugin consistently generates Dutch-language content.
  • Improved WordPress.org directory tags for more relevant AI content and blog generator searches.
  • Improved the short plugin description for clearer Dutch-language positioning.
  • Improved the WordPress.org description and FAQ wording for better discoverability.
  • Updated screenshot captions to match the current plugin functionality.
  • No functional changes to content generation.

1.1.0

  • Added title selection to the Blog Title Generator.
  • Added a button to send the selected title directly to the Blog Generator.
  • The selected title is automatically filled into the Blog Generator while article generation remains manual.
  • Added one optional saved writing style to the Blog Generator.
  • The saved writing style is automatically applied when generating new articles.
  • Added automatically prepared SEO data after article generation, including a meta description limited to 140 characters.
  • Added separate copy buttons for the meta title and meta description.
  • Improved the plugin dashboard and Support & Help documentation.
  • Added clearer information about the extended Content AI Agent plugin.
  • Added a WordPress.org review link on the plugin dashboard.
  • Updated the WordPress.org readme for version 1.1.0.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
  • Added Blog Generator.
  • Added Blog Title Generator.
  • Added H1, H2 and H3 structure for generated articles.
  • Added formatted article preview.
  • Added copy functionality for use in the WordPress editor.
  • Added OpenAI API settings and connection test.
  • Added configurable AI model.
  • Added Support and Help page.
  • Added information about Content AI Agent.
